For Order #1042 (Wireless Headphones, $129.00 – left earphone not working), here are the available resolutions under merchant policy:

| Option | Speed | Details |
|---|---|---|
| **Replacement** | **Arrives tomorrow** ⚡ | New headphones shipped now; return original within 14 days (prepaid label included) |
| Refund | 3–5 business days | $129.00 back to original payment method; return required |
| Keep Item + Partial Refund | Processed immediately | $40.00 back, keep the damaged item, no return needed |

**Fastest resolution to have a working product in hand:** **Replacement** — arrives tomorrow, which also matches the note that you're traveling tomorrow.

If speed of *money processing* (not product) is what matters most, **Keep Item + Partial Refund** is technically "processed immediately," but you'd keep the broken item and only get $40 back — not ideal given the item doesn't work.

Given your travel deadline, I'd recommend **Replacement**. Let me know and I'll select it — I won't take any action until you confirm.
